RPE is rate of perceived exertion, a 1 to 10 scale for how hard a set felt. A 10 means you couldn't have done another rep, 9 means one rep left in the tank, 8 means two, and so on.

It's useful because it lets you aim at effort instead of a fixed number, so a heavy day when you're tired and a heavy day when you're fresh both get judged fairly. Most working sets land around RPE 7 to 9, and you rarely need to grind at 10. Honest calls get easier with practice, since people tend to underestimate how many reps they had left early on.
